description: This file defines the SensorService class for Android, including its internal classes, methods, and interfaces related to sensor management, privacy, and system interactions.

classes.name: SensorService
classes.description: Main class managing sensors, including registration, privacy, connections, and system interactions.

classes.name: SensorService::ProximityActiveListener
classes.description: Interface for proximity sensor state change callbacks.

classes.name: SensorService::RuntimeSensorCallback
classes.description: Interface for runtime sensor event callbacks and configuration changes.

classes.name: SensorService::UidPolicy
classes.description: Manages UID active/idle states and access control.

classes.name: SensorService::SensorPrivacyPolicy
classes.description: Handles sensor privacy toggling and notifications.

classes.name: SensorService::MicrophonePrivacyPolicy
classes.description: Handles microphone privacy toggling, inheriting from SensorPrivacyPolicy.

classes.name: SensorService::AutoCallerClear
classes.description: Scoped class to clear and restore binder caller identity.

classes.name: SensorService::ConnectionSafeAutolock
classes.description: Ensures safe access to connection lists with proper locking.

classes.name: SensorService::SensorConnectionHolder
classes.description: Holds active sensor connections with thread-safe access.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the sensor service.

methods.name: SensorService
methods.description: Constructor for SensorService.

methods.name: cleanupConnection
methods.description: Cleans up sensor connections.

methods.name: checkAndReportProxStateChangeLocked
methods.description: Checks and reports proximity state changes.

methods.name: notifyProximityStateLocked
methods.description: Notifies listeners of proximity state changes.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables a sensor connection with specified parameters.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a sensor connection.

methods.name: setEventRate
methods.description: Sets the event rate for a sensor connection.

methods.name: flushSensor
methods.description: Flushes sensor data for a connection.

methods.name: addProximityActiveListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for proximity sensor state changes.

methods.name: removeProximityActiveListener
methods.description: Removes a proximity sensor listener.

methods.name: registerRuntimeSensor
methods.description: Registers a runtime sensor with callback.

methods.name: unregisterRuntimeSensor
methods.description: Unregisters a runtime sensor.

methods.name: sendRuntimeSensorEvent
methods.description: Sends a runtime sensor event.

methods.name: configureRuntimeSensorDirectChannel
methods.description: Configures a direct channel for runtime sensor.

methods.name: isSensorInCappedSet
methods.description: Checks if a sensor type is rate-capped.

methods.name: shellCommand
methods.description: Executes shell commands related to sensor service.

methods.name: threadLoop
methods.description: Main loop of the SensorService thread.

methods.name: getSensorList
methods.description: Returns list of available sensors.

methods.name: createSensorEventConnection
methods.description: Creates a new sensor event connection.

methods.name: createSensorDirectConnection
methods.description: Creates a direct sensor connection.
